correctness.rationale: Direct graph distance matrix has block entries 2^p(J-I) and J+(3^p-1)I. Complete 1+1+(n-1)+(n-1) eigenspace splitting gives the centered eigenvalues exactly. Subadditivity shows p<=1, the decreasing ratio 3^p/(2^p-1) yields the unique internal threshold for n>=5, all endpoint nullities follow from explicit signs, and analytic inversion yields the stated two-term expansion. The standalone package checker independently computes actual matrix-vector products for 5152 instances; finite tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Supremal negative type is a natural exact metric embedding invariant with an all-bandwidth kernel characterization. The infinite family is a canonical one-matching perturbation of K_n,n, yielding a strict improvement and a sharp nonzero second-order gain, plus exceptional endpoint Euclidean dimensions at the 6-cycle and 3-cube. This is a complete exact family classification rather than an arbitrary finite test or routine table recomputation.
